summary: Advance your negotiation and influencing skills for complex, high-stakes deals. Build strategies, tools, and playbooks you can apply immediately. Enrol now.
lede: Advanced negotiation training helps experienced professionals prepare for complex, high-stakes discussions and shape workable agreements. Participants learn to assess BATNA and ZOPA, map stakeholders and power, frame proposals, manage difficult interactions, and review outcomes using performance indicators, applying these methods to commercial and internal negotiations.
audienceIntro: This advanced negotiation and influencing training is tailored for experienced professionals who already manage high-stakes discussions and need a more structured, strategic approach to shaping outcomes.
modules: Styles, Conflict Modes, and Difficult Counterparts
Execution at the Table and Tactical Agility
Personal Influence Playbook and Action Plan
prerequisites: This is an advanced-level program designed for experienced professionals who already handle significant negotiations or stakeholder influence in their roles. You should have at least 5 years of professional experience that includes regular exposure to contract discussions, budget or resource negotiations, vendor or client interactions, or internal prioritisation debates. Prior exposure to basic negotiation concepts (interests vs positions, simple win-win approaches) is recommended but not mandatory; foundational ideas are briefly refreshed before deeper application. No coding or technical programming is required. Advanced concepts such as game theory, behavioural economics, and AI-assisted preparation are taught at operational application level: you will learn how to commission, interpret, and apply insights, not build algorithms or models.
